name: CloudFolder
tagline: Rust cloud folder sync for Windows 10/11 x64
description: CloudFolder is a Rust-based cloud folder sync tool aimed squarely at Windows 10/11 x64, with a trilingual README. It targets the niche of Windows users who want lightweight folder sync without heavyweight sync clients. An alternative written in Rust for a platform where sync options are usually proprietary.
highlights: Cloud folder sync written in Rust
Targets Windows 10/11 x64 with a trilingual README
Lightweight alternative to heavyweight sync clients
curatorNote: Windows folder sync is dominated by proprietary clients. A Rust alternative that is trilingual out of the box shows an unusual amount of care for a niche tool.
